audit_items.proof_trace: The by_root RPC handler serves data columns directly from storage (line 123) without validating gossip requirements. Reconstructed data columns are saved to storage (data_columns_reconstruct.go:88) without gossip validation, bypassing the 12 gossip checks including parent validation and proposer signature verification that only gossip-received columns undergo.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker triggers reconstruction by sending valid columns for a malicious block with an invalid parent or bad proposer signature. The reconstructed columns are saved to storage without gossip validation. When a peer requests those columns via by_root, the node serves the reconstructed (unvalidated) columns, propagating the malicious block's data columns to the network.
